name: Cueva de las Manos, Río Pinturas
description: In Argentina's Santa Cruz province, about 163 km south of the town of Perito Moreno, the Cueva de las Manos shelters walls covered in hundreds of hand outlines, made by blowing paint around a hand pressed to the rock. Created by Patagonian hunter-gatherers up to about 13,000 years ago, the paintings also show guanacos and hunting scenes, still vivid after millennia.
